wildly overconfident because: 
1) of successful venezuela experience 
2) more limited strikes on iran when iranians talked big, didn’t respond 
3) most problematically, people competing to flatter the chief give a systematically more positive bias to their briefs w potus

how can it be justified to the american people, never mind the rest of the world?
